localization.expected_solution: The surviving multi-line tag originates in markupsafe (the escaping library), NOT in jinja2 (whose striptags filter the app calls). At tag 2.1.1, markupsafe's striptags in src/markupsafe/__init__.py strips using two module-level regexes, `_strip_comments_re = re.compile(r"<!--.*?-->")` and `_strip_tags_re = re.compile(r"<.*?>")`, neither with re.DOTALL; because `.` does not match a newline by default, a tag whose markup spans multiple lines is not matched and is left in the output. The failure path is: jinja2 do_striptags (src/jinja2/filters.py), registered via FILTERS/DEFAULT_FILTERS (src/jinja2/defaults.py), calls Markup(str(value)).striptags() -> markupsafe striptags -> the newline-blind regexes. The agent must attribute the defect to markupsafe's strip regexes and explain that jinja2 only delegates to them.
evaluation_criteria: Attributes the surviving tag to markupsafe (the escaping library / dependency), NOT to jinja2
Names markupsafe's tag/comment strip regexes (in the escaping library's main module) as the site, and that they lack re.DOTALL / cannot cross a newline
Explains that `.` does not match newlines by default, so multi-line tags are not removed
Describes the cross-repo traversal: jinja2 striptags filter (do_striptags, wired via the filter registry) -> Markup.striptags in markupsafe

patch_at_fix_site.expected_solution: The agent leaves an uncommitted diff in /workspace/markupsafe that modifies src/markupsafe/__init__.py at the real fix site: the tag-strip (and comment-strip) regex compilation(s), adding re.DOTALL (or an equivalent newline-inclusive pattern), matching upstream commit e49d257126d0. A diff that only touches jinja2, or that pre-processes the body in the app, is not the correct site.
evaluation_criteria: git diff in the markupsafe workspace repo shows a modification to src/markupsafe/__init__.py
The change is in markupsafe, not jinja2
The change targets the tag/comment strip regex compilation, not an unrelated spot

patch_semantics.expected_solution: The patch makes the strip regexes match across newlines: it adds re.DOTALL to the `re.compile(...)` call for the tag regex (and ideally the comment regex), or switches the pattern to a newline-inclusive form like `[\s\S]`, exactly as the upstream fix does, so a multi-line tag is stripped like a single-line one.
evaluation_criteria: The diff adds re.DOTALL (or an equivalent newline-inclusive pattern such as [\s\S]) to the tag-strip regex compilation
The fix makes `.` (or the pattern) cross a newline so multi-line tags are matched
The fix is scoped to the strip regexes, not a broad rewrite of the escaping logic
